policy.reference_pool_role: Oxford A1 entry lines are reference evidence, not an automatic word-count promise or lesson checklist.
policy.sense_policy: Each selected set or chunk states the bounded meaning or function required at A1; unselected senses are not implied.
policy.recycling_policy: Guided production must be followed by retrieval in a distinct listed context before A1 consolidation.
policy.personalisation_policy: Open personal categories use bounded learner-relevant slots rather than arbitrary exhaustive lists.
policy.supplement_policy: A communicative need may justify a bounded form without a direct Oxford A1 line; the candidate evidence is then retained as its source reference.
